verdict.rationale: Letta is an agent platform with cloud accounts and APIs, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows it can issue scoped or least-privilege API keys for an agent. Secrets hide user-supplied keys from the agent, GitHub access is limited to granted repos, org roles and sharing controls govern teammates, and tool-permission callbacks approve or deny tool calls. These are related controls, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
